# Website Name
Personal Site of Joshua Chen
> Joshua Chen's Personal Site with About Me, Career, Project Samples, and Connect with Me Sections

## Page Routes - Website paths that users can take to reach the different webpage sections
- /about - About Me section has an Izakaya theme with fun facts about Joshua Chen
- /journey - Career section has a Tavern theme with selected work experiences
- /projects - Projects section has a Cyberpunk Cafe theme with sample projects
- /connect - Connect with Me section has a Magical Manor theme with additional links for social media and music making links
